title: Venture Global, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: Venture Global reported Q1 2026 LNG operational metrics: 480.8 TBtu sold with an implied weighted average fixed liquefaction fee of $3.82/MMBtu across 130 cargo exports. The filing covers two facilities—Calcasieu Pass (141.2 TBtu, 38 cargos) and Plaquemines (339.6 TBtu, 92 cargos). Full financial results will be announced with the quarterly earnings report.
key_points: Q1 2026 total LNG volume: 480.8 TBtu with implied weighted average fixed liquefaction fee of $3.82/MMBtu

Plaquemines facility: 339.6 TBtu sold, 92 cargos exported
Two DES cargos (8.3 TBtu) from Plaquemines will be recognized in Q2 2026 due to transit time

Full net income and cash flow results pending quarterly earnings announcement
